Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Used via Hugging Face transformers (transformers==4.57.1, AutoProcessor and AutoModelForImageTextToText with trust_remote_code=True) in a Python 3.11 conda environment, with extra packages (torch, pillow, einops, torchvision, accelerate, decord2, molmo_utils). Input is a chat-style messages list with text, video or image content, formatted via processor.apply_chat_template and run with model.generate. Quick Start examples cover general video QA, video pointing, video tracking (best with max_fps=8), multi-image QA and multi-image pointing.
quotes: pip install torch pillow einops torchvision accelerate decord2 molmo_utils

inputs = processor.apply_chat_template(
    messages,
    tokenize=True,
    add_generation_prompt=True,
    return_tensors="pt",
    return_dict=True,
)
